meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会检查你电脑上的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装是否正常：对比最新官方源码，逐项检查版本、配置、插件文件等，然后给出健康/警告/失败的报告，并说明下一步怎么做。它只做诊断，不会乱改你的文件。
howto.when: 当你要求做健康检查或审计安装、提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词，或在安装/更新/改配置后觉得 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 装得健不健康。
say.note: 会对照最新源码给出体检报告。

say.text: 更新 Codex 后总是报错，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 检查配置和插件，找出原因。

say.text: 用 lcx-doctor 做一次安装审计。
say.note: 直接调用这个诊断技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI setup, compares it with the latest upstream sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL health report citing evidence for each verdict. It only diagnoses; it won't change your files unless you explicitly ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request a health check or install audit, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or report Codex acting oddly after an install/update/config change, or suspect a stale/broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: It compares against latest sources and reports.

say_en.text: Codex keeps erroring after update; diagnose it.
say_en.note: Checks config and plugins to find the cause.

say_en.text: Run lcx-doctor for an install audit.
